sources.finding: Native multi-agent terminal canvas, paid local/SSH workspaces, role/context connections; product summary is documentation, not implementation inspection.

sources.title: MAO: native
sources.locator: Native architecture and FAQ
sources.finding: Rust GPUI desktop for Mac Intel/Apple silicon, Windows x64 and Linux x64 Wayland/X11. Local JSON/Markdown and backup scope.

sources.title: MAO: license
sources.locator: MAO comparison row
sources.finding: Vendor explicitly labels MAO closed source and a one-time purchase.

sources.title: MAO: workspace
sources.locator: Full documentation export; Reopen saved workspace state; hierarchy and add-project guides in full cached docs
sources.finding: Local canvas state persists; processes restart; existing Git repository required; trial limits one project.

sources.title: MAO: agents
sources.locator: Full documentation export; Presets, accounts, key pools, roles and terminal launch sections
sources.finding: Agent presets use separate provider accounts/models, local credentials and reusable roles. Role injection into ACP differs from PTY-only agents.

sources.title: MAO: chat
sources.locator: Full documentation export; ACP settings; framed chat, threads, attachments and prompt composer sections
sources.finding: ACP beta opt-in, Claude provider row default enabled; Antigravity unavailable; remote chat unsupported; seven threads and attachment/history bounds.

sources.title: MAO: bridge
sources.locator: Full documentation export; Task delivery, peers, orchestrator, note access and bridge surface sections
sources.finding: Correlated task IDs, explicit connection permissions, delivered/completed/failed states, results and local Orchestrator operations. Older docs exclude some remote operations now described in release prose.

sources.title: MAO: routine
sources.locator: Full documentation export; Scheduled routines and routine CLI
sources.finding: Recurring and one-shot prompt/reminder routines; min interval30 s; agent must run; does not keep computer awake.

sources.title: MAO: layers
sources.locator: Full documentation export; Create/status/land/archive/restore/switch layer guides
sources.finding: Git worktree layers, status/progress, conflict/dirty checks before landing to Ground, archive/restoration.

sources.title: MAO: files
sources.locator: Full documentation export; File editor, diff, changes and history guides
sources.finding: Plaintext editor, scoped path checks, file/hunk staging, split/unified diff and read-only200 commit history with size caps.

sources.title: MAO: portals
sources.locator: Full documentation export; Browser and Android/iOS portal sections
sources.finding: Authorized connected browser/device inspection and control with screenshots; native device dependencies and platform restrictions.

sources.title: MAO: settings
sources.locator: Full documentation export; Diagnostics, notification, backups, retention and updates sections
sources.finding: Opt-in desktop diagnostics off by default; excludes prompt/output/notes; local reports. Backup TTL14 days/512 MiB, excluded data, desktop update preference and licence restriction.

sources.title: MAO: privacy
sources.locator: All policy paragraphs
sources.finding: Account metadata in PostHog, download/installer reports, desktop preference, separate website session replay and Vercel counting, support-mediated account deletion. No contractual retention duration stated.

sources.title: MAO: remote
sources.locator: SSH and WSL FAQ
sources.finding: Paid SSH Linux host server installed by desktop, ephemeral password and fingerprint confirmation, retry/restart/resume and state conflict choice; WSL on Windows.

sources.title: MAO: release
sources.locator: Version sections 0.18.3, 0.18.2, 0.18.1, 0.18.0, 0.17 and 0.16; each retains its own release date
sources.finding: Latest0.18.3 fixes workstream move. Recent releases add local workstreams/questions, cross-machine task delivery, flows, sleep/wake and overview; remote testing/feature gaps explicit.

sources.title: MAO: flows
sources.locator: Flows, script authority, run retention and untested scope
sources.finding: Human-authored bounded flow graph; script stages require human approval/start, not sandboxed; last10 runs and restart continuation documented.

sources.title: MAO Linux download installer
sources.locator: report function and report install_started; MAO_NO_INSTALL_REPORT branch
sources.finding: Readable shell reports installation start/success/failure plus opaque download ID by default; MAO_NO_INSTALL_REPORT=1 returns before request. This is installer reporting, separate from desktop diagnostics.

sources.title: MAO0.18.3 Linux distribution installer scripts
sources.locator: install_tree; install_into; target CLI detection
sources.finding: Readable installer copies desktop binary, remote-server binaries and skill trees locally and installs skills into detected Claude/Codex/OpenCode and generic agent directories. Main desktop and remote-server code are compiled ELF binaries, not readable JS/npm/VSIX. Archive SHA256 pins the inspected distribution.

sources.title: MAO 0.18.3 bundled flow manual
sources.locator: relay/share/relay/agent-skills/mao-flows/SKILL.md: Writing a plan; A stage, Where it leads, A time limit
sources.finding: Shipped skill prose documents at most 64 stages, 8 outcomes and a 7-day stage limit. This is documentation, not source-inspected implementation.

sources.title: MAO homepage data disclosure
sources.locator: Signing in shares your email; One update check per launch; Diagnostics are off by default
sources.finding: Homepage separately discloses two first-sign-in crash counts, device/account identifiers and version/system/licence update checks, alongside optional app diagnostics. It describes licence renewal about weekly; release 0.18.1 says daily.
